Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this game. Pakistan have a 2-0 lead in this series and with series already in their bag, they would be looking to grab the remaining 10 points of the World Cup Super League in the next game. West Indies also would like to finish on high and get those crucial 10 points. The final ODI will be played on Sunday, 12th of June and it will start at 4.30 pm IST (11 am GMT). Our coverage though will start in advance. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan, says early on, the wicket was two-paced so they just wanted to build a partnership. Adds that due to the middle order collapse they were short of a few runs. Regarding Khushdil Shah, they wanted to give him the finishing role but he applauds the tailenders for scoring crucial runs. Shares that he knew their spinners will get purchase and lauds the way they bowl.

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies, says that it was a tough game for them. Tells that they gave away 20 runs extra and adds that the conditions were tough. Mentions that their death bowling has been an issue for quite a long time and they are a young team and hopefully they will improve. Tells that credit should be given to Nawaz for the way he bowled and the conditions were tough and they needed to build partnerships and there were many soft dismissals. Hopes that they will learn from the experience and come back better in the next game.

Mohammad Nawaz is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his brilliant spell of 10-0-19-4. He says he was just focusing on his basics and to bowl in good areas. Adds that the way the ball was spinning, he had an idea and he knew there was some help in this pitch for the spinners. Tells that finger spinners are comparatively easier to play but they too were getting some spin. Shares that he is confident with the bat too and as an all-rounder he only wants to improve.
Time for the Presentation.

Earlier in the game, West Indies bowlers bowled well to restrict Pakistan to a par score of 275. The pitch had some help for spinners as Akeal Hosein showed with the ball in hand bowling a very good spell and picking up three wickets on the way. Pakistan lost the way with the bat in the middle after yet another century partnership between Imam-ul-Haq and Babar Azam. Both of them got to their respective fifties but overall, it was their brilliant bowling performance, especially the pressure their spinners built in the middle overs that won them this game.

This game was another classic example of how much West Indies are dependent on Shai Hope to bat through the innings. He departed in the first over and though there was a good counter-attacking partnership between Mayers and Brooks, the real test was always going to be against the spinners on the track that had some help for them. Mayers lost his wicket off the last ball of the Powerplay 1 and that opened the floodgates as spinners were brought into the attack by Babar Azam. Nawaz struck in his very first over and skipper, Pooran joined Brooks in the middle. However, after a 30 runs partnership, Nawaz got rid of Brooks and West Indies were soon restricted to 120-7 and eventually were bowled out for just 155. Nawaz finished with four wickets while Wasim took three and Shadab finished with two wickets. Not to forget, Shaheen Afridi who took a big wicket of Shai Hope in the very first over.

What a bowling performance this has been from Pakistan! They have taken an unassailable lead of 2-0 in this three-match ODI series and have grabbed 20 important World Cup Super League points from this series so for. For West Indies, on the other hand, this game will be an eye-opener in terms of showing them how much they need to improve in order to compete with the best in the business in an ODI game.

OUT! TIMBER! West Indies are bundled out! Touch fuller and on off, it says a bit low. Anderson Phillip stays back to defend but misses and the ball beats his outside edge and hits the top of off. Pakistan win by 120 runs and win the series by going 2-0 up!
Length ball, outside off, knocked to point for a single.
Shorter and on midde. Hosein gets low and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Four leg byes! This one lands on middle and spins away from Hosein. He misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. It rolls down to fine leg for a boundary. Khan appeals but it was turning down side.
Tossed up on middle, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off, doesn't spin much. Phillip looks to defend inside the line and gets beaten.
Anderson Phillip is the last man in.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust! Shadab Khan with a nicely tossed up delivery that pitches on off and turns into the batter. Walsh tries to drive it away but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal. The umpire raises his finger but Hayden Walsh reviews it. The Ball Tracking shows that it is umpire's call on wickets hitting and the decision stays. Hayden Walsh has to walk back.
A fuller delivery on off. Akeal Hosein heaves it to long on for a single.
This is fuller outside off. Walsh drives it to covers.
A fuller delivery on off. Akeal Hosein pushes it to mid on for a single.
On a length, on middle. Walsh works it to mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! LBW! Mohammad Wasim strikes and West Indies lose another one. Wasim lands it on a length, on off and the ball nips back in sharply. Alzarri Joseph is stuck on his crease as he looks to defend. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal. The umpire raises his finger and Pakistan are just two wickets away now from a big win. Hayden Walsh is the next man in.
WIDE! This is short on middle. Alzarri Joseph ducks under it. The umpire calls it wide for height.
A fullish delivery on off. Alzarri Joseph drives it to covers.
Lands on a length, on off. Alzarri Joseph blocks it out.
A loopy delivery, outside off, it is driven to deep cover for a single.
Very full and on middle. Defended out.
Tossed up, full and on off, spinning away. Alzarri Joseph blocks it out.
Tossed up on middle. Hosein rocks back and tucks it to deep square leg for a single
Slightly full and on leg, tucked to square leg.
Tossed up on middle. Blocked out.
This is full and on middle. Alzarri Joseph blocks it out.
Flatter and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Flatter and outside off. Joseph slaps it to point.
Very full and on middle. Defended out.
Full and on middle, pushed to long on for a single.
Four byes! Flighted ball, around off. This one spins back in sharply and bounces as well. Hosein looks to play at it but misses and the ball goes past the keeper and into the fine leg fence.
Flatter, googly and outside off. Hosein tries to chase this one but fails to connect.
A loopy ball, outside off. Hosein works it to covers.
FOUR! Much needed! Tossed up, full and on off. Hosein smashes it high and straight down the ground for a one-bounce four.
Flatter and around off. Joseph checks his shot and drives it past cover for a single.
Flighted but this is too full and on middle. Joseph pushes it back to Khan.
Slightly short and around off. Hosein pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Straight on middle. Joseph blocks it out solidly.
An arm ball, too full and on off, driven to covers.
Flatter ball, outside off. Joseph punches it to covers.
Length ball, drifting on middle, Joseph rocks back and forces it to mid on.
Tossed up, outside off, moving a touch away. Joseph prods to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Spinning onto the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
This one just holds a bit, on off. Joseph chips it well in front of mid on.
Sharp turn there! Full ball, outside off, turning away. Joseph looks to drive but misses.
A googly, full and on middle. Blocked back to the bowler.
Shorter, outside off, spinning away. Left alone.
On a length and around middle and leg, it lands and spins away sharply, beating the outside edge of Joseph.
Shorter and outside off. Joseph looks to cut but gets a bottom edge, through the keeper and to fine leg. Two runs.
Too flighted on middle, pushed back to Nawaz.
This is much quicker, on middle. Hosein looks to work on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Slanting on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, slanting on middle. Joseph clips it to square leg for a single.
On middle. Punched back to Nawaz.
Leg bye! Length ball, drifting on the pads. Hosein skips down and misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to fine leg and they take a leg bye.
A googly to end the over, on the shorter side and on middle and leg. Joseph looks to flick on the back foot but misses and gets hit on the pads. Height might be the issue.
A ripper! Fuller, it lands on leg and spins away sharply. Joseph is squared up as he tries to defend and the ball spins past his outside edge.
Alzarri Joseph is the next batter in.

OUT! LBW! A spinner strikes and this time it is Shadab Khan! A leg breaker, short and it lands on leg and spins away. Romario Shepherd hangs on the back foot and looks to flick it but misses and gets rapped on the back leg. An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Romario Shepherd reviews it. UltraEdge shows no bat while Ball Tracking shows wickets hitting but on umpire's call. The on-field decision stays. West Indies are in big trouble now.
Flighted, full and on off. Shepherd smashes it to covers where the fielder dives to his left and makes a sharp stop.
On middle. Blocked out.
Leg bye! Tossed up on leg. Hosein misses his clip and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but that was pitching outside leg. A leg bye taken
Tossed up, outside off. Hosein swings across and splices it to deep point for a single.
In-drifter, on middle. Shepherd rocks back and tucks it to square leg for a single.
Romario Shepherd walks in now.

OUT! TIMBER! Nawaz gets another one and this time it's the big wicket of Pooran! What a gem of delivery this is from Nawaz! This is nicely tossed up, full and around off. It does spin a bit in and Pooran defends the wrong line here. The ball goes past his outside edge and hits the off pole. Pooran goes after getting a good start.
Too full and on middle, eased down by Hosein to long on for a run.
Akeal Hosein is the next man in.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! The spinners are enjoying the deck and Nawaz is bowling really well to earn rewards. Nawaz floats this on a length and outside off. Powell lunges a bit and looks to defend but the ball turns past his blade and takes the outside edge. Mohammad Rizwan makes no mistake and West Indies are in a spot of trouble here. 160 more runs to win for West Indies.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Mohammad Nawaz

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on off, spinning in. Pooran fends it to fine leg for a single.
On a length and outside off. Powell strokes it to point.
Flatter and outside off. Powell dabs it past backward point for a brace.
SIX! Welcome boundary! Khan flights it on a length and around off. Powell uses his feet as he comes down the track and hits it over covers for a boundary.
This one spins back in on middle. Pooran punches it to long off for a single.
Full and on off, pushed to long off for a single.
Fuller and on middle. Played back to the bowler.
Shadab Khan is back on. Three overs for 17 runs so far.
Tossed up on off. Pooran prods and works it to short third man.
This one spins into the left-hander. Pooran rocks back and blocks it.
Flatter and on middle. Pooran keeps it out.
In the air but safe! Tossed up, full and on middle. Pooran kneels and looks to sweep but gets a top edge and it drops safely at deep square leg. Two runs.
Slanting on the pads. Powell tucks it to deep square leg for a single.

Not out! An arm ball from Nawaz, around middle. Powell looks to defend on the front foot but gets an inside edge onto the pads.  Pakistan put up a huge appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Powell reviews it. The replay shows there was a thick inside edge. Not out it is!
Maiden from Haris Rauf! Short delivery, outside off. Pooran looks to upper cut it but misses. 174 needed now from 180 balls!
Make it seven dots in a row after that wicket of Brooks! On the shorter side, on off. Pooran mistimes his punch back to the bowler.
Another dot! Back of a length, on off. Pooran blocks it off the back foot.
A fullish delivery on off. Pooran drives it to the cover fielder this time.
Continues with that shortish length, around off. Pooran dabs it square off the wicket on the off side and initially looks for a single but is sent back.
Back of a length and angling into off from 'round the wicket. Pooran defends it towards mid off.
Slower in the air, on off. Powell defends it off the front foot. Brilliant over by Mohammad Nawaz, absolute class!
Tossed up, on off. Powell drives it to covers.
Rovman Powell is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Mohammad Nawaz strikes! Shamarh Brooks does not review it and rigthly so and it looks dead straight. After a lovely tossed up delivery, Nawaz delivers an arm ball here. On middle and Brooks looks to sweep it. He misses and the ball hits him on the pads. There is a hugh appeal and the umpire raises his finger. This is a huge, huge wicket for Pakistan as Brooks has the ability to rotate strike in these middle overs. He is gone now and Pakistan are right on the top here!
Wow! A lovely tossed up delivery, outside off. Brooks tries to drive it away but the ball turns and beats the outside edge of his blade.
A flatter one on off. Brooks blocks it comfortably.
On the shorter side, turning into middle. Pooran pushes it to long on for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Brooks blocks it out.
On the shorter side on middle. Pooran pulls it to deep square leg for a single.

Ohh...dropped! A short delivery, outside off. Pooran cuts it hard but straight to point. Imam-ul-Haq there puts down a straight forward chance. It can prove costly for Pakistan as Pooran has the talent to take this game away from Pakistan.
Full again, around off. Pooran drives it to the cover fielder.
FOUR! Good timing by Pooran! Overpitched delivery, outside off. Pooran drives it through cover-point and gets a boundary as the ball beats the diving Shaheen Afridi at deep.

On a length, on middle at 144.7 kph. Brooks tries to work it towards the leg side. However, he closes his bat face a bit early and gets a leading edge towards covers. It goes in the air for some time but away from the fielder. A single taken.

Dot to end the over! A full delivery on off. Pooran takes a big stride forward and blocks it. The dot ball percentage of West Indies is quite high in ODI cricket and they need to do better in that aspect today.
On the shorter side, around off. Brooks uses the depth of the crease and works it to long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Brooks drives it left of mid off.
Nicely driven for a single! It is full and outside off. Pooran drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
A flatter one again and on the shorter side this time. Brooks punches it to long on for a single.
A full delivery on off. Brooks drives it to covers.

Drinks! The spinners of Pakistan are doing a good job as they are creating chances and have piled some pressure. These two batters need to take the game deep if they need to win this and Nicholas Pooran need to step up in this crucial game.
SIX! Nicholas Pooran breaks the shackles with a biggie! This is a tossed up delivery on off. Pooran gets under it and tonks it straight down the ground for a maximum.
A fuller delivery on off. Brooks drives it to sweeper cover for a single.

Lovely delivery! Shadab Khan appeal for a caught behind but Rizwan is not convinced. However, they eventually decide to take the review. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. So, Brooks will continue. Coming to the ball - It is a tossed up delivery, outside off. Brooks tries to drive it away but the ball turns away and beats the outside edge of his blade.
A fuller delivery on middle. Pooran works it to mid-wicket for a single.
This is fuller and on off. Pooran drives it through covers for a couple.
A flatter one on off. Pooran blocks it off the back foot.
Tossed up on off. Brooks drives it back to the bowler.
A flatter delivery and slightly shorter on middle. Brooks works it towards the leg side.
Gives a bit of air, on middle. Brooks drives it back to the bowler.
Nawaz bowls it fuller on off. Brooks defends it off the front foot.
On off and bit fuller. Pooran pushes it towards the leg side and takes a single.
A flatter one and on the shorter side, around off. Pooran tries to cut it but does not get any timing.
A half-tracker on middle. Pooran rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Pooran tucks it towards the leg side.
Googly around off. Pooran tries to defend it off the back foot. However, he gets the thick outside edge to backward point and comes back for the second run.
Tossed up on off. Brooks drives it to long off for a single.
Another dot delivery! Slower in the air, on off. Brooks blocks it off the front foot.
A full delivery on off. Brooks drives it to the cover fielder.
Another dot ball! They need to rotate the strike here, especially Pooran. This is full on middle. Pooran works it to mid-wicket.
Pushed quicker, around off. Pooran looks to punch it away but mistimes it.
WIDE! Big turn there! Pitched on off and it turns down the leg side as Pooran looks to clip it. Wided.
A fuller delivery on off. Pooran drives it to mid off.
Gives a bit of flight this time, on off. Brooks drives it to long off for a single.
Darts another one on off. Brooks blocks it out.
Flatter one and quicker on off. Brooks goes back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Quicker and flatter on off. Pooran defends it back to the bowler. So, both the spinners have started well here. This will be a big test for these two Windies batters!
Googly, however the ball is on the shorter side on middle. Brooks goes back and pushes it to long on for a single.
Drags his length back a bit and it turns away from off. Brooks punches it to covers.
Lovely fuller delivery on off. Brooks drives it back to the bowler.
On the pads, Pooran tucks it to fine leg for a single.
Starts off with a shorter delivery, around off. Brooks punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Slightly shorter on middle. Pooran pushes it towards mid-wicket off the back foot.
Flatter delivery on off. Pooran leans forward and defends it towards the leg side.
Nicholas Pooran walks out and he needs to step up to the occassion.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Mohammad Nawaz produces a perfect delivery and King walks back on duck. This is a classic left-arm orthodox spinner's delivery. Nicely flighted pitching on middle. King tries to work it towards the leg side but the ball turns a bit and beats the outisde edge of his blade to knock over the off pole. Pakistan are right back in this game now.
Slower in the air and fuller on off. King defends it off the front foot.
On the shorter side, on off. Brooks punches it to long on for a single.
A flatter one on off. Brooks blocks it off the front foot.
Brandon King walks in at number 4. Also, it is time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. Mohammad Nawaz is into the attack now.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! A much needed breakthrough for Pakistan and Wasim strikes! One shot too many from Mayers. This is on a length and on middle, nothing doing much with the deck but Mayers swings across the line and fails to connect. The ball ends up hitting the stumps. Delight for Pakistan.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
SIX! Pakistan are serving fuller-length and West Indies are enjoying it! Another one slanting on the pads. Brooks flicks it over square leg for a biggie.
FOUR! This is an exhibition from Brooks!Sheer class! Full and on off. Brooks leans a bit and drives it firmly through covers for a boundary.
In the air and safe! Too full and on leg. Mayers chips it over mid-wicket and it lands safely. A single.
A slower one, outside off. Mayers is totally deceived as he swings across.
Another bouncer and Brooks lets it go.
A short one, around off. Brooks sways away from it.
On a length, slower and on off. Mayers steers it to third man for a single.
Bangs a bouncer on middle. Mayers sits under it.
Rauf changes the angle and serves a fuller delivery, on off. Mayers drives nicely but straight to mid off.
FOUR! Glorious drive! A length ball, just around off. Mayers plays a classic cover drive through covers for a boundary.
10 off the over! Touch fuller and on middle, drilled down to mid on.
Length ball, around leg, it is clipped past square leg for a couple.
Length ball, on the pads. Brooks misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
FOUR! Classy shot! 50 up for the Winides! Full again, on middle. Brooks rocks back and pushes it into the gap, through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On middle, fuller, pushed to mid on.
FOUR! West Indies are off to a really good start! Fuller and on off. Brooks chips it with full control over mid-wicket and bags a boundary.
This is full and slanting on middle. Brooks wrists it to the right of mid on and takes a single. 11 runs off the over.
Length and on middle. Blocked out.
Full and on off, Mayers drives it to mid on and takes a quick single.
SIX! Mayers is in an aggressive mood here! This is on a length and outside off. Mayers steps down and swings across. Not where he intended but the ball sails over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Three runs taken! Afridi angles it on the pads. Brooks flicks it past mid-wicket. The fielder gives a chase and slides near the ropes to save a single.
On a length and outside off. Brooks dabs it to short third man.
Length and outside off. Mayers tries to cut it but misses.
Wasim angles this across and slowers his pace. Mayers looks to play at it but misses.
FOUR! Wow! Mayers is hitting some superb shots! On a length and just outside off. Mayers shows full face of the bat and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Length again on middle. Mayers dead bats it again.
On a length and on middle. Blocked out.
FOUR! yet another beautiful shot from Mayers! Starts with a short of a length and on off. Mayers hangs back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Mohammad Wasim is into the attack.
Shaheen Afridi with a shorter delivery, on off. Brooks sways away from the line of the ball.
A fuller delivery on middle. Brooks works it towards mid on.
Shaheen Afridi comes 'round the wicket and bowls it full on middle. Brooks drives but gets the inside half of his blade. The ball goes towards mid-wicket.
Tad full this time, on off. Brooks drives it to mid off.
On the shorter side again, around off. Brooks rides the bounce and punches it to covers.
Back of a length, around off. Brooks pushes it towards the off side.
Rauf bowls on a length, outside off, angling across. Mayers tries to drive it away but misses.
SIX! What a shot! Caribbean flair written all over it. A short delivery on middle. Mayers plays that pick up shot and the ball travels all the way over the backward square leg fence.
Angling into middle. Brooks wrists it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Brooks looks to drive it away from his body but gets beaten.
FOUR! Lovely timing from Brooks! Rauf drifts on the pads again. Brooks glances it past square leg for a boundary.
On a length, on middle. Brooks works it to deep square leg for a couple.
A full delivery on middle. Mayers pushes it aerially back to the bowler but luckily for him it falls short.
A length delivery on off. Mayers blocks it from his crease.
A fullish delivery on off. Brooks pushes it to mid off for a single.
This is a full delivery and angled across the batter, outside off. Brooks drives away from his body and gets beaten off the outside edge of his blade.
Shaheen Afridi goes for a short delivery, around off. Brooks sways away from the line of the ball.
WIDE! A slower delivery but way outside off. Brooks leaves it alone.
Did that carry? No, it falls short of the fielder at point. The delivery is full and outside off. Brooks drives it off the outside half of his blade and the ball falls short of the point fielder.
A length delivery angling across the batter. Mayers tries to punch it away but gets beaten.
A very full delivery on off. Mayers looks to block it but gets the inside edge of his blade.
On the shorter side, around off. Mayers pushes it straight to the point fielder this time.
Back of a length, around off. Mayers punches it past point for a couple.

FOUR! Good effort by Imam-ul-Haq near the fence but a boundary for Mayers in the end. It is full and outside off. Mayers leans forward and drives it through covers. Imam-ul-Haq chases it and as he tries to keep the ball inside the ropes, he touches the fence. So a boundary for Mayers to get off the mark!
A length delivery, around off. Mayers looks to punch it towards the off side but gets the inside edge towards the leg side.
Shamarh Brooks is the next man in and Haris Rauf will start from the other end.

OUT! CAUGHT! Here we go... Shaheen Afridi with a wicket in the first over again! It is followed up by his trademark celebration style. This delivery it full and around off. Hope drives but does so aerially and ends up hitting it straight to Fakhar Zaman at covers. He takes an easy catch and Pakistan have got the start they needed. This is a big wicket of Shai Hope!
Commentary.Howout: c Fakhar Zaman b Shaheen Afridi

Commentary.Commentary: Overpitched delivery with a hint of inswing. Hope drives it back to the bowler.
Pulls his length back a bit, on off. Hope blocks it solidly from his crease.
FOUR! West Indies and Shai Hope are underway with a boundary! Shaheen Afridi with that inswinger again. It drifts on the pads a bit and Hope flicks it towards deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Very full again and shaping into the batter. Hope blocks it out.
Shaheen Afridi starts off with his trademark first delivery! A full delivery that is swinging into the batter on middle. Hope though does well to defend it.
